question: An air traffic controller needs to control the landing times of n aircrafts: Flights must land in the order 1, ..., n. Flight j must land in time interval [aj , bj ]. n = 10. [a1, b1] = [0, 60], [a2, b2] = [10, 70], [a3, b3] = [20,80], [a4, b4] = [30, 90], [a5, b5] = [40, 100], [a6, b6] = [50, 110], [a7, b7] = [60, 120], [a8, b8] = [70, 130], [a9, b9] = [80, 140], [a10, b10] = [90, 150]. The objective is to maximize the minimum separation time, which is the interval between two landings. Find the maximal minimum separation. Provide your answer rounded to the nearest time.

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "n": 10,
    "a": {1: 0,  2: 10, 3: 20, 4: 30, 5: 40,
          6: 50, 7: 60, 8: 70, 9: 80, 10: 90},
    "b": {1: 60, 2: 70, 3: 80, 4: 90, 5: 100,
          6: 110, 7: 120, 8: 130, 9: 140, 10: 150},
}

GOLD_ANSWER = None


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    n = d["n"]
    flights = list(range(1, n + 1))
    pairs = [(i, j) for i in flights for j in flights if i < j]

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.F = pyo.Set(initialize=flights)
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=pairs, dimen=2)

    model.land = pyo.Var(
        model.F,
        within=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=lambda m, i: (d["a"][i], d["b"][i]),
    )
    model.sep = pyo.Var(within=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    def sep_rule(m, i, j):
        return m.land[j] - m.land[i] >= m.sep

    model.separation = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=sep_rule)

    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.sep, sense=pyo.maximize)

    return model

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()

    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=pairs)

    model.sep = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=sep_rule)

    return model

import pyomo.environ as pyo

DATA = {
    "n": 10,
    # indexed 1..n ; store per-index value in dicts
    "a": {1: 0, 2: 10, 3: 20, 4: 30, 5: 40,
          6: 50, 7: 60, 8: 70, 9: 80, 10: 90},
    "b": {1: 60, 2: 70, 3: 80, 4: 90, 5: 100,
          6: 110, 7: 120, 8: 130, 9: 140, 10: 150},
}

GOLD_ANSWER = None


def build_model(data=None):
    d = data or DATA
    n = d["n"]
    flights = list(range(1, n + 1))
    # consecutive-pair set
    pairs = list(range(1, n))

    model = pyo.ConcreteModel()
    model.I = pyo.Set(initialize=flights)
    model.P = pyo.Set(initialize=pairs)

    # Landing time for each flight, within its [a, b] window
    model.t = pyo.Var(
        model.I,
        domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals,
        bounds=lambda m, i: (d["a"][i], d["b"][i]),
    )

    # Maximal minimum separation among consecutive landings
    model.s = pyo.Var(domain=pyo.NonNegativeReals)

    # --- Constraints: one per atomic statement ---

    # "Flight j must land at or after a_j"
    def rule_lower(m, i):
        return m.t[i] >= d["a"][i]
    model.c_lower = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=rule_lower)

    # "Flight j must land at or before b_j"
    def rule_upper(m, i):
        return m.t[i] <= d["b"][i]
    model.c_upper = pyo.Constraint(model.I, rule=rule_upper)

    # "Flights land in order 1..n and are separated by at least the min separation"
    def rule_sep(m, i):
        return m.t[i + 1] - m.t[i] >= m.s
    model.c_sep = pyo.Constraint(model.P, rule=rule_sep)

    # Objective: maximise the minimum separation
    model.obj = pyo.Objective(expr=model.s, sense=pyo.maximize)

    return model
